description: This file contains test scripts for simulating race conditions in git commit creation. It defines test scenarios for concurrent commit operations using custom editors and checks for proper handling of orphan and non-orphan commits.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Defines a script to be used as a custom editor during git commit in the test scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success with a specific description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the specified commands fail as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
